recommendation: Keep the source fix for the current Contract resource. If FHIR-55563 or a broader Contract refactoring later lands on this branch, it can supersede these lines as part of that separate scope.
issue_request: FHIR-13403 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked that the Contract resource support Ricardian contract concepts for digital exchange of processable contract information.
initial_application: Historical GF#13403 commits beginning with 39dbca76 and continuing through the 2018 ballot-preparation commits applied the Ricardian Contract model, including legal state, contract terms, offers, assets, valued items, friendly/legal/rule representations, and legallyBinding support. Current source retained those features, but several definition strings still referred to the obsolete Contract.binding name.
additional_context: Contract is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml and the Contract pattern mapping exception files are current build inputs. The later FHIR-55563 proposal to move Contract out of R6 normative content is only Resolved - change required in this default run context and its removal commit is not in this branch. Community searches found only tracker/commit notifications and no conflicting Confluence or Zulip rationale.
reconciliation: Updated Contract.identifier, Contract.contentDerivative, Contract.term.offer.topic, and Contract.signer text to point at Contract.legallyBinding[x], cleaned a malformed sentence in that same Ricardian representation paragraph, and aligned the Event and Request mapping exception copies of the Contract.identifier requirements.
source_changes: source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml: replaced obsolete Contract.binding/quoted binding references with Contract.legallyBinding[x] in Ricardian representation and signature/source-of-truth prose.
source/contract/contract-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated the copied Contract.identifier requirements text to match the corrected StructureDefinition wording.
source/contract/contract-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated the copied Contract.identifier requirements text to match the corrected StructureDefinition wording.
